brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 「数理规则书」里有 list 的归纳规则。
hint.en: The “Rule book of numbers” has an induction rule for list.

t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-list"></level-ref>声明的 list = [] | x :: xs 也给出同样几类规则；它的归纳从 xs 走到 x :: xs。
t.en: The list = [] | x :: xs declared in <level-ref to="decl-list"></level-ref> gives the same kinds of rule; its induction steps from xs to x :: xs.
